2608.29054.title: Let Prompts Bridge Defense Knowledge: Transferable Graph Purification via Vulnerability-Aware GPL
2608.29054.paper_summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone for representing complex relational dependencies in diverse multimedia tasks, particularly in cross-platform user interest modeling and cross-modal semantic alignment. In the real world, a practical defense against graph adversarial perturbations is needed. However, we observe that the prevailing adversarial purification methods are essentially domain-restricted defenses, which leads to the following shortcomings: (1) single-domain data provides insufficient structural and semantic diversity for learning robust purification criteria; (2) training of domain-specific defense strategies from scratch consumes substantial computational cost. To address the above limitations, we propose a transferable graph purification scheme, named ProGAP, to bridge adversarial defense knowledge via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning. Firstly, to capture universal adversarial patterns, a perturbation-capture edge detector is pretrained on data-rich graphs by jointly modeling topological and semantic information. Subsequently, to achieve more knowledge transfer w.r.t. robustness, vulnerability-aware prompts are designed that inject targeted purification guidance into biased nodes, during which the pretrained detector adapts to distribution shifts in downstream graphs without parameter-laborious updates. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our ProGAP achieves 1%-9% improvement, and reduces the time consumption by up to 2.2x. The code for ProGAP is available at https://github.com/Lieyoufffff/ProGAP.
2608.29054.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）已成為在各種多媒體任務中表示複雜關聯依賴的基石，特別是在跨平台用戶興趣建模和跨模態語義對齊方面。在現實世界中，需要一種實用的防禦措施來對抗圖形對抗擾動。然而，我們觀察到現行的對抗淨化方法本質上是領域限制的防禦，這導致了以下缺點：（1）單一領域數據提供的結構和語義多樣性不足，無法學習穩健的淨化標準；（2）從零開始訓練特定領域的防禦策略消耗了大量計算成本。為了解決上述限制，我們提出了一種可轉移的圖淨化方案，名為 ProGAP，旨在通過脆弱性感知的圖提示學習來橋接對抗防禦知識。首先，為了捕捉通用的對抗模式，一個擾動捕捉邊緣檢測器在數據豐富的圖上進行預訓練，通過共同建模拓撲和語義信息。隨後，為了實現更多關於穩健性的知識轉移，設計了脆弱性感知的提示，這些提示將針對性的淨化指導注入偏見節點，在此過程中，預訓練的檢測器適應下游圖中的分佈變化，而無需繁瑣的參數更新。實驗結果表明，與最先進的基準相比，我們的 ProGAP 實現了 1%-9% 的改進，並將時間消耗減少了多達 2.2 倍。ProGAP 的代碼可在 https://github.com/Lieyoufffff/ProGAP 獲得。
